title: Explosion at house beside school in Afghanistan's Kunar kills at least six students and injures 97
location: Andar Ser (Dand-i-Sir) area, Kunar province, eastern Afghanistan
summary: An explosion at a house beside a middle school in Kunar province, eastern Afghanistan, at about 10am on 28 November killed at least six students and injured 97, according to local officials; one government source put the death toll at seven. Provincial officials said the house belonged to people involved in mining who had stored explosives there. Investigators were at the scene and the figures were described as preliminary.
impact_assessment: Observed: a mass-casualty incident affecting schoolchildren and stretching provincial health services, with some injured moved to Jalalabad. Potential: the toll may rise; the cause has not been independently established.
priority_rationale: MODERATE: a mass-casualty incident involving children; officials describe it as an accidental detonation of stored mining explosives rather than an attack.

confirmed_facts.text: An explosion at a house next to a school in Kunar province on the morning of 28 November killed at least six students and injured 97.

reported_claims.text: The house belonged to people involved in mining operations who had stored dynamite there.
reported_claims.attributed_to: Mawlawi Sami-ul-Haq, Kunar director of information and culture, and a government source

reported_claims.text: Seven students were killed; four of the injured were moved to the regional hospital in Jalalabad and the rest were treated in Kunar.
The casualty figures are preliminary and could change.
reported_claims.attributed_to: Mawla Dad, head of Kunar Provincial Hospital

unknowns: Number of the injured who are children
reassessment_triggers: Evidence that the explosion was a deliberate attack or a claim of responsibility
Significant rise in the death toll
monitoring_actions: Follow the provincial investigation and updated casualty figures
